title: Pick a caching layer
dek: Each option reads itself out and the numbers land as they're spoken. Answer any card, in any order, then send.
foot: Latency figures are p95 from the load test on 2026-08-20. Costs are list price at our current volume.

cards.name: Redis or Postgres for the session cache
cards.headline: Take Redis — it holds p95 under 4ms at our peak, where Postgres crosses 40ms.
cards.say: Card one. The session cache. Postgres costs us nothing extra, because we already run it. Redis adds fourteen dollars a month, but it held p95 latency under four milliseconds through the whole load test. Postgres crossed forty milliseconds at peak. My call is Redis.

chart.label: p95 latency through the load test

options.label: Redis only for hot keys
options.sub: half the cost, more code to maintain
